title: De sartor nui sian maestri (Anonymous)
desc: Anonymous, De sartor nui sian maestri. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Canto dei sartori (Perugia G.20). From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ano3237); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
